contentList.content: Your unarmed attacks ignore resistance to Bludgeoning damage, and count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to non-magical damage.
You are immune to being <LSTag Tooltip="CharmedGroup">Charmed</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag>.
Your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> is added to your Initiative rolls, and you can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag>.
Strike a flurry of blows against all enemies in front of you.
Strike a flurry of blows against all enemies in front of you, possibly knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
Strike a flurry of blows against all enemies in front of you, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OPEN_HAND_NO_REACTIONS">Staggering</LSTag> them, making them unable to take reactions.
Strike a flurry of blows against all enemies in front of you, possibly pushing them [1] away.
You shrug off attacks, gaining Resistance to physical damage.
